title: 1 Chronicles 25
paragraphs: ¹ David and the army commanders set apart for the ministry the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, those who were to prophesy with harps, lyres, and cymbals. The list of those who carried out this service was as follows: ² From the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah — the sons of Asaph, under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied at the king's command. ³ From the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah — six — under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the harp, giving thanks and praise to the LORD. ⁴ From the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth. ⁵ All of these were sons of Heman, the king's seer, given to him through God's promises to exalt him. God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

⁶ All of them served under their father's direction in the music ministry of the house of the LORD, with cymbals, lyres, and harps, as the king had commanded through Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman. ⁷ The total number of them, along with their kinsmen who were trained in music for the LORD — all who were skilled — was two hundred and eighty-eight. ⁸ They cast lots for their duties, young and old alike, teacher and student together. ⁹ The first lot, which went to the family of Asaph, fell to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, together with his brothers and sons — twelve in all; ¹⁰ the third to Zaccur, with his sons and brothers — twelve;

¹¹ the fourth to Izri, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ¹² the fifth to Nethaniah, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ¹³ the sixth to Bukkiah, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ¹⁴ the seventh to Jesharelah, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ¹⁵ the eighth to Jeshaiah, with his sons and brothers — twelve;

¹⁶ the ninth to Mattaniah, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ¹⁷ the tenth to Shimei, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ¹⁸ the eleventh to Azareel, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ¹⁹ the twelfth to Hashabiah, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ²⁰ the thirteenth to Shubael, with his sons and brothers — twelve;

²¹ the fourteenth to Mattithiah, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ²² the fifteenth to Jeremoth, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ²³ the sixteenth to Hananiah, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ²⁴ the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ²⁵ the eighteenth to Hanani, with his sons and brothers — twelve;

²⁶ the nineteenth to Mallothi, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ²⁷ the twentieth to Eliathah, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ²⁸ the twenty-first to Hothir, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ²⁹ the twenty-second to Giddalti, with his sons and brothers — twelve; ³⁰ the twenty-third to Mahazioth, with his sons and brothers — twelve;
³¹ the twenty-fourth to Romamti-ezer, with his sons and brothers — twelve.
